items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days
items.claim: Moses' hand-stretching gesture toward heaven produced total darkness over Egypt lasting exactly three days
items.action: stretched forth his hand toward heaven

items.quote: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days
items.claim: The darkness mechanism prevented all sight and voluntary movement for exactly three days
items.mechanism: darkness as mechanism of sensory and motor deprivation

items.quote: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings
items.claim: Israelite dwellings retained light while surrounding Egypt experienced darkness during the same three-day period
items.mechanism: selective light preservation as physical mechanism
